title: Awards Racing
promptLanguage: Put one glossy car in a full-viewport Three.js scene and keep the play control, the driver, and the car choice as real HTML on top. Sound stays silent until a labelled control turns it on, and the type jumps once from the play word to the small status line.
notes: Choosing sound off opens a dark lobby where a single car sits in the WebGL view and the play control, driver card, and car card stay in the page. A sound control remains in the corner, and the frame rate readout shows the scene is doing real-time work.
reducedMotion: When motion is reduced, keep the driver, the car name, and the play control as still HTML and leave the canvas on a single frame with sound off.
